contracts.commit_point: Runner.run(triage_agent, full_input) at main.py:92: the registered input guardrail executes within this run, and a triggered tripwire aborts the run (exception caught at main.py:98-99) before any handoff or tool effect commits; the preempted downstream effect would commit at requests.get(url) inside get_weather (tools/weather.py:14).
contracts.declared_mechanism: Input guardrail 'detect_not_related_question' defined with @input_guardrail (main.py:30-37), which runs guardrail_agent (an Agent with output_type NotRelatedQuestion, main.py:20-28) and returns GuardrailFunctionOutput(output_info=result.final_output, tripwire_triggered=result.final_output.is_not_related); registered on triage_agent via input_guardrails=[detect_not_related_question] (main.py:75). A triggered tripwire raises InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered out of Runner.run, caught at main.py:98-99, which prints a travel-only refusal message.
contracts.forbidden_condition: A user question classified as not related to traveling (guardrail_agent emits is_not_related=true) being processed by the triage agent pipeline without the guardrail tripping — i.e., off-topic input causing Runner.run(triage_agent, ...) to proceed to model calls, handoffs, or tool effects such as external weather-API requests.
pending_binding_information: The openai-agents SDK internals are not in supplied source: the exact lifecycle point at which input_guardrails execute relative to the first model call and to handoffs is inferred only from InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered propagating out of Runner.run (main.py:92, caught at 98-99).

Whether the triage-level input guardrail also re-executes for sub-runs initiated via handoff (weather/restaurant/attraction agents), or only for the initial triage_agent run, cannot be determined from supplied source.
Effects performed by get_attractions and get_restaurants (tools/attractions.py, tools/restaurants.py) are not in supplied views and must be obtained to bind those tools to the guarded pipeline.

Session-history handling after a trip (history remains stale at main.py:81/96 since the except branch does not update it) and its interaction with multi-turn guardrail classification is not specified.
contracts.protected_operation: Execution of the triage agent run for user input via Runner.run(triage_agent, full_input), including handoffs to the weather/restaurant/attraction agents and any tool executions they perform, for travel-related requests.
contracts.protected_resource: The triage agent run and its downstream specialist-agent tool effects, concretely the OpenWeatherMap HTTP API accessed by the get_weather function tool (tools/weather.py:13-14).
contracts.protection_obligation: Non-travel-related user input must trip the detect_not_related_question input guardrail registered on triage_agent, aborting the agent run at Runner.run (via InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered) so the triage pipeline never proceeds to handoff agents or their downstream external API tool calls (concretely, get_weather's OpenWeatherMap HTTP request), with the tripwire caught at the call site and the request refused.
scope_limits: Only the weather tool's external effect is evidenced in supplied source; reviewer wording also names attractions (and the pipeline includes restaurants), but tools/attractions.py and tools/restaurants.py are not supplied, so their effects are unverified.

The obligation is enforced at triage_agent entry only; no input_guardrails are shown on weather_agent, restaurant_agent, or attraction_agent (main.py:40-68), so downstream agents are protected only transitively through the guarded triage run.

The trip decision is produced by an LLM classifier (guardrail_agent, model gpt-4o-mini, main.py:20-28); classification correctness, false-negative rates, and runtime behavior are outside this contract.
The OpenWeatherMap request's own authentication, validation, and HTTP semantics are out of scope; the request is in scope only as the downstream guarded effect.
The observed handling of a trip is limited to printing a refusal message at main.py:99; no other remediation or logging is shown.

missing_information: tools/attractions.py and tools/restaurants.py are not among the supplied sources; the reviewer claim that the guardrail also gates external API calls for attractions/restaurants is only partially supported (imports at main.py:9-10 and tool attachments at main.py:57, 67) and their effect types cannot be confirmed.

The openai-agents SDK's internal ordering of input-guardrail evaluation versus model inference, handoffs, and tool execution is not present in supplied source; the 'before the triage agent runs' timing is inferred from the InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered exception propagating out of Runner.run (main.py:92, 98-99).
Whether input guardrails are re-evaluated on handoff sub-runs (weather_agent, restaurant_agent, attraction_agent) is not determinable from the supplied code.
Runtime effectiveness and prevalence of the guardrail (e.g., LLM classifier false negatives/positives) are not assessable from source and are intentionally not decided here.
